key_impacts: Accident remains ongoing; melted fuel must be cooled to avoid further radioactive releases.
Contaminated cooling water leaks into basements while ~400 tons/day of groundwater flows in.
Thousands of large tanks store contaminated water across the site, with risk of toppling.
People in Japan continue to bear damage and face severe, complex issues from the disaster.
Complete environmental decontamination is described as impossible.
evidence_snippets: A large-scale nuclear disaster at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi… directly caused by the Great East Japan Earthquake and Tsunami of March 11, 2011.
The accident at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant is not over.
Coolant water becomes extremely contaminated, leaks into basements; ~400 tons/day groundwater flows in; the site is packed with 1,000‑ton tanks that can topple.
